row.body: The map is folded around a return key, but the departure sheet omits the way back. A pencilled note asks the next driver to call before opening the gate.
row.title: Return route withheld

sidecar.gloss: A driver receives no return route and must call before opening the gate.
sidecar.rival_reading: A field team could keep a return route private for routine security; the note does not show why the gate was closed.
